parsing_rationale: The document is a technical API specification. I have mapped the endpoints to functional requirements and the data models to entities. Security and rate limiting are mapped to non-functional requirements. Since the document focuses on the 'How' (API contract) rather than the 'Why' (Business Goals), several high-level template sections are missing.

project_info.brief_explanation: RESTful API specification for managing football matches, teams, leagues, and user following functionality.
project_info.source_context: API Contract document defining endpoints, data models, and constraints.

sections.title: API Contract: Football Match Manager
sections.raw_content: This document defines the RESTful API endpoints for the Football Match Manager backend.

sections.title: Authentication
sections.raw_content:
All endpoints (except auth endpoints) require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

sections.title: Authentication
sections.raw_content:
- `POST /auth/register` - Register a new user
- `POST /auth/login` - Login and receive JWT token
- `POST /auth/logout` - logout (client-side token removal)

sections.title: Matches
sections.raw_content:
- `GET /matches` - Get list of matches with optional filtering
  - Query Parameters:
    - `leagueId` (UUID): Filter by league
    - `dateFrom` (ISO string): Matches on or after this date
    - `dateTo` (ISO string): Matches on or before this date
    - `status` (string): Filter by status (upcoming, live, finished)
    - `search` (string): Search by team name (home or away)
    - `page` (int): Page number for pagination (default: 1)
    - `limit` (int): Items per page (default: 20)...
- `GET /matches/:id` - Get a specific match by ID
- `GET /matches/:id/followers` - Get users following a specific match (requires auth)

sections.title: User Follows
sections.raw_content:
- `POST /follows` - Follow a match
  - Body: `{ "matchId": "uuid" }`
- `DELETE /follows/:matchId` - Unfollow a match
- `GET /follows` - Get all matches followed by the current user (requires auth)

sections.title: Teams
sections.raw_content:
- `GET /teams` - Get list of teams (optional search)
  - Query Parameters:
    - `search` (string): Search by team name
    - `limit` (int): Limit results (default: 50)

sections.title: Leagues
sections.raw_content:
- `GET /leagues` - Get list of leagues
  - Query Parameters:
    - `country` (string): Filter by country
    - `active` (boolean): Filter by active leagues

sections.title: Error Responses
sections.raw_content: All endpoints return appropriate HTTP status codes... Error response body: { "error": "string", "message": "string", "details": "object (optional)" }

sections.title: Rate Limiting
sections.raw_content:
- Auth endpoints: 5 requests per minute per IP
- All other endpoints: 60 requests per minute per user

sections.title: Versioning
sections.raw_content: API version is included in the URL path (`/api/v1/`). Breaking changes will increment the version number.

elements.content: All endpoints except auth endpoints require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header.
Allow new users to register via POST /auth/register.
Allow users to login and receive a JWT token via POST /auth/login.
Retrieve a list of matches with filtering by leagueId, date range, status, and team search, including pagination.
Retrieve a specific match by its unique ID.
Allow an authenticated user to follow a match via POST /follows.
Allow an authenticated user to unfollow a match via DELETE /follows/:matchId.
Match entity containing homeTeam, awayTeam, dateTime, venue, league, status, and scores.
Team entity containing name, abbreviation, crestUrl, and foundedYear.
League entity containing name, sport, country, logoUrl, and currentSeason.
User entity containing email, displayName, and avatarUrl.
Auth endpoints limited to 5 req/min per IP; other endpoints limited to 60 req/min per user.
API versioning must be handled via URL path (/api/v1/).
